Kit summary

Candy TrapBasic
Deals 100% ATK DMG to a single enemy and inflicts extra 220% ATK Detonation DMG, with a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Burn] for 2 turns.
Sugarcoat BombActive
Deals 145% ATK DMG to all enemies and inflicts extra 145% ATK DMG. The more layers of [Candy Bomb] the targets have, the more extra DMG dealt, up to 725%. This extra DMG is considered as [Burn] DMG.
Trick or TreatPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
If allies deal DMG to enemies during their turns, when the turns end, Little Jack has a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Candy Bomb] on the targets and deal extra DMG equal to 20% of his ATK at least, caps at 100% of his ATK. This extra DMG is considered as [Burn] DMG and Skill DMG. The more layers of [Candy Bomb] the targets have, the more extra DMG dealt. Each enemy can have up to 40 layers of [Candy Bomb]. This effect cannot be triggered by pursues and attacks.
Pranky Pumpkin Lv.1Each time [Candy Bomb] is inflicted, inflicts 1 layer of [Limp Body] on the target for 2 turns. [Limp Body]: Each layer reduces the owner's ATK by 5%, up to 8 layers; refreshes the duration when inflicted repeatedly.
Pranky Pumpkin Lv.2Increases all allies' (excluding self) Mastery by 40% of Little Jack's initial Mastery. Each ally can gain at most 100% Mastery in this way.
Trick and TreatActiveExclusive Lv.3
Summons 4 pumpkin bombs continuously, each of them deals 285% ATK DMG and 285% ATK [Burn] DMG to a random enemy and inflicts 1 layer of [Candy Bomb] on the target.
Pranky Pumpkin Lv.3Gains 1 layer of [Pumpkin! Pumpkin!] after casting Trick and Treat. Each layer provides 1 more pumpkin bomb summoned by Trick and Treat, up to 10 layers, and will not be removed when Little Jack dies or at the wave transition. Reduces the CD of Trick and Treat by 2 turns if no enemy is killed after casting Trick and Treat.
